sentence: This project develops AI methods that help make sense of the complex data collected by high-energy physics experiments.
This project changes an open-source toolkit for speech recognition so it is easier to use and works with deep learning tools.
This project plans a research center on Digital Twin research, where a Digital Twin is a virtual replica of real-world objects and processes.
This project studies how dry places such as deserts respond to added nitrogen, using measurements in soil and water and a model of watersheds.
This project builds machine learning methods that use an infrared laser to detect threat chemicals such as explosives from a safe distance.
This project tries to find out how to help soybean plants cool their flowers and pods during heat stress and drought so they make more seeds.
This project studies how biological molecules differ in their states by pulling on individual molecules with a rapidly increasing force.
This project investigates whether female non-human primates compete over males and how this affects their reproductive success.
This project teaches cybersecurity strategy, federal policy, risk management and incident response in formal classroom settings and through an annual cybersecurity competition.
This project studies the skeletons of extinct four-legged animals to design robots that can move over uneven ground and through confined spaces.
This project studies sudden changes in the behavior of large complex systems, including spiral waves and striped patterns.
This project analyzes three years of radio telescope data to detect a faint signal from hydrogen gas during the Cosmic Dawn.
This project builds course materials and a hands-on practice system that teach how to test the answers of Artificial Intelligence security tools.
This project develops AI methods that help scientists choose which experiments to run next, so promising discoveries need far fewer trials.
This project studies how seawater heat and low oxygen, alone and together, affect a reef-building coral from larvae to adult.
This project builds immersive calculus exercises where software manages routine calculations so the focus stays on real-time problem-solving decisions.
This project builds a method that projects laser dots onto objects and uses the reflected light and scattering patterns for object recognition.
This project creates quantum materials in which information travels as organized waves that lose very little energy.
